title: Compare version numbers
hints: Compare **tuples of ints**, not strings: `(1, 10, 0) > (1, 9, 2)` is `True`, but `"1.10.0" > "1.9.2"` is `False`. A small helper that returns `(self.major, self.minor, self.patch)` keeps every comparison one line.
`from_string` is a `@classmethod`: strip an optional leading `"v"`, `split(".")`, check there are exactly 3 parts that all pass `.isdecimal()`, then `return cls(*(int(p) for p in parts))`.

In `__eq__`/`__lt__`, start with `if not isinstance(other, Version): return NotImplemented`. Decorate the class with `@functools.total_ordering` so `>`, `<=` and `>=` come for free from `__eq__` and `__lt__`.
